dataset_metadata.source_transparency: Calibrated Empirical Simulation (Labeled as Simulated per Section 11)

hypothesis_tests.hypothesis: H1: Sports Complex attendance drops significantly during Exam Weeks compared to Non-Exam Weeks
hypothesis_tests.conclusion: Reject H0 (p < 0.05). Attendance is significantly lower during exam periods, demonstrating academic workload precedence.

hypothesis_tests.hypothesis: H2: Library occupancy increases significantly during Exam Weeks compared to Non-Exam Weeks
hypothesis_tests.conclusion: Reject H0 (p < 0.05). Library occupancy surged significantly by ~140+ students on average during exams.

hypothesis_tests.hypothesis: H3: Food Outlet demand increases significantly during Sports Event / Tournament days
hypothesis_tests.conclusion: Reject H0 (p < 0.05). Interconnected campus flow confirmed: sports events drive significant positive spillover to food outlets.
